data.title: Simulated spectrum of SSX-A-001
data.description: Synthetic 0.75–5.0 µm spectrum: a Sun-like continuum (reflected sunlight) with injected absorption features and noise.

extraction.method: Simulated aperture photometry with annulus background subtraction
extraction.notes: 102 channels: one per plane of a SPHEREx mosaic cube. Flagged points mark apertures containing a bad pixel.

comparisonSeries.label: Sun-like continuum (no absorption)
comparisonSeries.description: What reflected sunlight would look like from a perfectly grey surface. Smooth model curve.
